record.question: Do not start till I say.
record.explanation: Answer C: Conjunction. “Till” introduces the clause “I say”, so it is a conjunction. Independent check: “Till I say” is a subordinate clause, so “till” functions as a conjunction. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/till. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
